name: Mailprotector Quarantine & Messages
description: Quarantine triage across all five scopes (reseller/customer/domain/ user_group/user): message fields (`quarantine_type`, `decision`, `score`, scoring `results`), releasing a single message via `/deliver`, bulk release via `/deliver_many` with its silent scope-mismatch skip and the `all_selected` release-everything switch, and the release permission flags in configuration.
